Salamah narrated to me, al-Humaydī narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, he said:

‘I heard Jābir talking about something like 30,000 Ḥadīth .’ Muslim said, I heard Abū Ghassān Muhammad bin Amr ar-Rāzī say, ‘I asked Jarīr bin Abd il-Hamīd: ‘Did you meet al-Hārith bin Hasīrah? He said: ‘Yes, Shaykh of lengthy silence; he persisted in a grave matter.’
